results.description: REGISTRATION_REJECT; evidence must include the reject frame.

final_json.root_cause: 5GMM cause 9 'UE identity cannot be derived by the network': The AMF received a REGISTRATION_REQUEST but could not extract or validate a valid SUCI/GUTI to identify the subscriber.

evidence.note: UE initiated registration from 192.168.30.169
AMF rejected with mm_cause=9 (identity cannot be derived)
AMF released the UE context after rejection
